svg.title: ProsperoCraft roadmap
svg.desc: White completed milestones: Full 26.x.x support, microphone support, shader support, OpenGL support. A winding road continues through dark planned milestones: NeoForge support, 1.21.x support, Forge support, 1.20.x support, .mrpack imports, 1.19.x support, 1.18.x support, 1.17.x support, 1.16.x support and older versions.
